description: Get a Canton Network video that CCPEDIA has cached (curated channels: Canton Network, Digital Asset, Sync Insights, Canton Foundation, Daml, Digital Asset Training) by its YouTube id: title, channel, publish date, description and the transcript, with the time of each passage when timings are stored. Pass query to get only the passages that mention a term, each with its time and a link that opens the video there. Pass offset to keep reading a long transcript past the first part. CANTON-ONLY and limited to videos already in CCPEDIA's index. Does NOT fetch arbitrary YouTube videos (use a dedicated YouTube tool for that). Obtain ids from list_videos or search.

offset.description: Character position to start reading the transcript from, for a long one. The response names the offset that continues the read.

query.description: Return only the passages of the transcript that mention these words, each with its time and a link that opens the video at that moment. Replaces the plain read; offset is ignored.

transcript_chars.description: Transcript characters to return. Default 12000; raise it (max 200000) for the full text, or set 0 for metadata only.

name: get_video
